//: rootDir is `src`, and `include` is src ONLY, because tsc roots its output at
the common ancestor of every input. With examples/ in scope that ancestor was
the repo, so the emit landed at dist/src/index.js while package.json pointed at
dist/index.js. Importing by package name failed with 'Cannot find module', and
nothing in the build said so — tsc and the typecheck were both clean.
examples/ is STILL type-checked, by tsconfig.check.json, which is what
`npm run typecheck` runs. Removing them here changes what is emitted, not what
lib includes DOM for `crypto.subtle` and `atob`. Both are equally standard in
Node 18+, but their type declarations live in the DOM lib, not in @types/node.
